I told Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is **Gate 47**.

- **What I checked:** Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I read that channel on their behalf. I didn't use `search_messages`.
- **What the channel shows:** Pree posted Dock 23 on 2026-10-14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning, saying they'd read the wrong line. No later message in the channel changes it.
- **Knowledge base:** the only active entry for the lane says Gate 47, which matches the channel.

My reply also mentioned the Dock 23 correction so Hollis doesn't copy the old value into the account sheet. Nothing else was needed: no mail, no finance figures and no approvals.
